items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: They could play like Guy Lombardo and they could swing like Count Basie. It was the most amazing band I've ever been with in my life. They could play so many different styles and this put them in the category of Guy Lombardo.

ctx.x: rhythm section first." And after that the trumpets and the saxophones. In this particular band they had a guy that played - they called him like a clown. He did all the acrobatics and everything on his back with this tenor and all that. They had other musicians that were real true musicians and what I did when I began writing, I'd teach this guy how to phrase with them because he was a little corny - the one that was doing all the tricks while he was playing. They did little acts and they did everything. They…
They worked a lot of white dates?
